sheets.caption: A streamer review desk for sourced chat checks, audience votes and earlier-moment clips.

The actual review desk keeps the original claim, source links and verified excerpt together.
The VOD result shows stored words, their stream time, transcript coverage and the confirmed clip.
Viewer History lets the streamer select several messages as context for a check.
Final dev and single heldout measurements, generated from the complete frozen-engine reports.
The model proposes, code verifies the result, and the streamer controls publication.
An actual twitch.tv VOD reply contains the stored quote, timestamp and clip; account labels are hidden.
Actual Codex instruction-reading footage beside the project’s agent rules.
French and Spanish chat examples use recorded model results and the same verified-source review.
Final dev and heldout latency percentiles include every input and exclude paid search discovery.
